description.value: Port Kells Branch is a compact (1,200 sq ft) neighbourhood public library in Surrey's Port Kells area, operated by Surrey Libraries. It offers free computers, free Wi-Fi (including Eduroam for university students), self-checkout, and a 24-hour book return drop. The branch is notably car-dependent — the nearest bus stop is 1.8 km away — which is worth noting for cyclists navigating to or from the site.
